text: Write the ending of a story called Lost and Found, about finding something important that had
been missing for a long time. In your story, create a sense of suspense and drama.
Write two contrasting diary entries (300–450 words each). The first is by a girl who is going to stay
with a family in another country as part of a school trip; the second is by the girl’s mother, on the
day of departure. In your writing, create a sense of their outlook and mood.
Write a descriptive piece about a busy train station. In your writing, focus on sound, movement
and colour to help your reader imagine the scene.
Section B: Writing for an audience
You have read an article in a magazine about whether more shops should be open 24 hours a
day, 7 days a week. Write a letter to the editor of the magazine, responding to the article and
giving your views.
Two students will be taking part in a school debate about employment. One of the students believes
that people should choose a job on the basis of salary; the other student feels that job satisfaction
is the most important consideration. Write the texts of their speeches (300–450 words each).
Your class has produced a short video on health and safety issues at school. Write the voiceover
script for this video, which will be posted on the school website.
